name: Actual Roommates
source:
The story of an over-confident girl who stumbles face-first into building her own lesbian harem(or a romantic relationship, if you prefer those), all while navigating a new living situation, new friends, corporate espionage, dealing with her past as a troublemaker, owning a cat and other miscellaneous horny situations.
